title: Write or revise an abstract
exit_check: Problem, debate, gap, contribution, test, and justified boundary are legible.

title: Build an introduction
exit_check: An internal problem precedes the central concept; the contribution and inferential route are clear.

title: Reconstruct a literature conversation
exit_check: Every source has an argumentative function and the remaining problem is precise.

title: Develop a theoretical account
exit_check: Definition, conceptual work, conditions, counterfeits, and boundaries are operational.

title: Test with cases
exit_check: Every case isolates a target condition and changes or confirms a theoretical judgment.

title: Write an objections section
exit_check: Strongest threats have been grouped and admitted into the theory's conditions or limits.

title: Revise a paragraph
exit_check: One principal action, clear direction, a warranted advance, and no dispensable repetition.

title: Revise sentences and inference
exit_check: Predicates reveal relations; connectives name supported logical steps.

title: Polish academic diction
exit_check: Terms are stable, verbs bear explanatory work, and modal force is justified.

title: Perform a final pre-submission review
exit_check: Architecture precedes prose polish; twelve checks are human-scored and evidence-backed.
